meta_description: Handlaid Stone Ltd supplies quality natural and decorative stone in Liverpool. Bespoke cutting, fast delivery, competitive pricing. Call 07565 142354 for a quote.
hero_eyebrow: Natural Stone Specialists — Handcut & Delivered Fast
hero_subhead: Beautiful natural stone delivered to your Liverpool site on time, every time. Bespoke cutting available.
services_subhead: From garden features to commercial facades, we source, cut, and deliver exactly what your project needs.

services.title: Flagstones & Paving
services.desc: Hardwearing natural stone flags in sandstone, limestone, and slate. Perfect for patios, terraces, and pathways across Merseyside. Cut to your exact dimensions.

services.title: Decorative Walling Stone
services.desc: Handpicked blocks and facing stone for garden walls, retaining features, and architectural detail. Colour-matched and sized to specification.

services.title: Bespoke Stone Cutting
services.desc: Custom cutting service for edges, curves, and specialist profiles. We work from your drawings or site measurements to deliver precision stonework.

services.title: Slate Supplies
services.desc: Premium Welsh and imported slate for roofing, cladding, and interior features. Graded for durability and aesthetics.

services.title: Gravel & Aggregate
services.desc: Decorative and structural aggregates — chippings, shale, and crushed stone. Bulk quantities delivered and spread on site.

services.title: Stone Advice & Sourcing
services.desc: Can't find the stone you need? We source specialist materials and advise on durability, maintenance, and cost-effective alternatives for your project.

about_pullquote: We source honest stone and cut it right. No pretence, no waste, fair prices.
about_para_1: Handlaid Stone has been supplying natural stone to Liverpool builders, landscapers, and homeowners since 2006. We work directly with quarries across the UK and Europe, cutting out middlemen so you get quality material at a fair price. Our team knows every stone in stock and can advise on the best choice for your soil, climate, and budget.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on reliability. You'll find us on Helsby Road in Fazakerley, and we deliver across Merseyside and into North Wales. Whether you need a single pallet for a garden wall or tonnes for a commercial project, we pride ourselves on clear communication, honest timescales, and stone that's been properly handled from quarry to your site.

reviews.text: Ordered flagstones for our patio in Woolton last spring. Handlaid sourced exactly what we needed, delivered on time, and the blokes helped unload and lay them out. Honest dealing, good prices. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Peter K.

reviews.text: We've been using Handlaid Stone for six years on commercial jobs. They're reliable, their stone is always top quality, and they turn bespoke cuts around fast. You know where you stand with them.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare sourcing slate for a render detail on a refurb. David at Handlaid found exactly what the architect wanted, cut it to spec, and it was with us within five days. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Sarah M.
